integrity: Exact join and union proof supplied with a self-contained finite verifier; no claim of independent validation or novel generic polynomial-time decidability.
limitations: The formula is restricted to cographs and the all-length-two-path P3-convexity; checking finitely many graphs is supplementary to the universal proof; published-equivalence searches are incomplete in principle.
title: Cograph \(P_3\)-convex-set enumerators and the sharp nonuniversal bound
